description: This file defines the `SubscriptionPlan` model class that interacts with subscription plan data in a database for the OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for retrieving individual subscription plan records, lists of subscription plans with filters, and total count of subscription plans.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription plans, including fetching specific plans, lists with filters, and total count.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a single subscription plan record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves an array of subscription plan records, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscription plan records in the database.
